name: Freshsales
description: Freshsales is Freshworks' cloud-based sales CRM that uses Freddy AI for lead scoring, deal recommendations, and automated email writing alongside kanban-style pipeline tracking.
best_for: Sales teams at companies of varying sizes — Freshworks reports 74,000+ businesses use the platform — seeking AI-assisted lead management and a 360° customer view.
features: AI-assisted lead capture, qualification, and routing
Kanban-style deal tracking with drag-and-drop cards
360° customer view across preferred communication channels
Freddy AI lead scoring, intent analysis, and deal recommendations
Check-in/check-out tracking for field sales meetings
Voice and image-to-text note capture in the mobile app
